methodology: One record per substantive section and cited source; three already-published sections are also logged for the newly added, source-verified claims. The ledger records only the assertion the opened source supports. Metadata alone is not claim verification. All records remain independently review-required. Newborn material was placed in its existing dedicated NP II newborn material identity to avoid duplicating thermal/danger-sign instruction in the maternal lesson.
